features.quote: Abandoning a truly impossible task is correct behavior, not a defect
features.justification_quote: Without these you can't distinguish "model is fragile" from "task is impossible so any reasonable agent quits."

features.quote: Add hard turn/cost caps per run and a circuit breaker.
features.justification_quote: Long-horizon + many cells + repeats × judge calls = real spend.

features.quote: The scientifically meaningful target is the gap between stressor and matched-solvable conditions
features.justification_quote: A high induction rate with no control comparison is uninterpretable.

features.quote: Cross-family judging + human calibration is non-negotiable.
features.justification_quote: If the judge shares lineage with the subject it'll have correlated blind spots.

features.quote: Bake "correct refusal/de-escalation on impossible tasks" into the rubric as a non-defect.
features.justification_quote: Otherwise you'll punish exactly the robust behavior you want.
